description: The readings a human watching a long autonomous run must be able to get from the projection. This file is the CONTRACT; tools/projection.py is the implementation; tools/tests/test_dashboard_contract.py renders representative states and asserts every row appears. It exists because the completeness figure was previously established by running a script by hand and writing the number down, which is the manually-transcribed-count defect this pack refuses everywhere else.
how_to_read: `marker` is a literal that must appear in the rendered projection for at least one of the representative states. It must DISCRIMINATE: an independent reader removed every real `subject:` line and the test still passed, because the marker was the word `subject` and the static panel title `audit subject vs candidate` contains it. A marker that another part of the page prints regardless is a marker that cannot fail, so each is now the literal form the reading itself takes — and `test_a_marker_that_matches_something_else_is_caught` removes each reading's own lines from a rendered view and asserts its marker disappears with them.
